custom_notes: Windows 11 + Git Bash. All website commands run from the website/ subdirectory.
Never commit directly to master for feature work; every change gets its own branch + PR.
Deploy is GitHub Pages via .github/workflows/deploy.yml, triggered by a push to master.

ci_status_check._comment: The only workflow (deploy.yml) runs on pushes to master, so feature-branch pushes have no CI run to wait for and the check would time out. Re-enable if a branch/PR CI workflow is added.
